description:
Buy a quoted phone number with explicit price confirmation.

        This charges the setup fee and first month immediately, then renews monthly.
        The purchase requires the user's authorization for that number and cost.
        Expired or changed offers return 409 without authorizing a different price.
        Each quote can buy at most one number.

        A retry with the same quote and ``idempotency_key`` refers to the original purchase.
        After a timeout, a new quote starts a different purchase and can buy a second number.
        A returned retry key is available after a timeout or server error.
        A 4xx failure returns no retry key; that failed request cannot be reused.
        A rejected or ambiguous registration selection returns 422.
        A purchase does not assign an answering agent automatically.
        Returns the number record and ``idempotency_key``, or an error with any available retry key.

confirm_total_cents.description: The offer's ``setup_cents`` plus ``monthly_cents``, in USD cents, as the user authorized it.
confirm_total_cents.title: Confirm Total Cents

country_code.description: Country of the number being bought, as an ISO alpha-2 code: the ``country_code`` sent to ``quote_numbers`` for this offer.
country_code.title: Country Code

idempotency_key.description: Retry key. The ``idempotency_key`` from an earlier response refers to that original request instead of starting a new one. Omitted: a new key is generated and returned.
idempotency_key.title: Idempotency Key

llm_model.description: The calling agent's provider model ID, as shown in the client's model configuration when available. Recorded for analytics.

number_type.description: Kind of number being bought: copy the offer's ``number_type`` from ``quote_numbers``. Hail checks it against the offer.
number_type.title: Number Type

subject_type.description: Whose approved registration may be used: the user's own (``person``) or their company's (``business``). Omitted: either.
subject_type.title: Subject Type

verification_id.description: Which approved registration covers this purchase: an ``id`` from the offer's ``verifications``. Give it when the offer lists more than one approved registration. Omitted: the only approved one, if any.
verification_id.title: Verification Id

name: acquire_number

capabilities.description: Channels this number supports, e.g. ['voice'], ['sms'], or both.
capabilities.title: Capabilities

country_code.description: ISO alpha-2 country code this number belongs to.
country_code.title: Country Code

idempotency_key.description: Key that identifies this exact request when retrying.

inbound_registered.description: True while the number is attached for inbound calls at the carrier and on Hail's LiveKit inbound trunk. Set when voice_agent_id is set.
inbound_registered.title: Inbound Registered

is_dedicated.description: True if this number is owned by the organization. False for shared-pool numbers.
is_dedicated.title: Is Dedicated

sms_agent_id.description: Agent that answers texts to this number. Null: texts only reach your webhooks.
sms_agent_id.title: Sms Agent Id

subject_name.description: Name of the person or company the verification used to buy this number is for. Null when no verification was used or the name is unknown.
subject_name.title: Subject Name

subject_type.description: Who the verification used to buy this number is for: 'person' or 'business'. Null when no verification was used.
subject_type.title: Subject Type

verification_id.description: Hail id of the verification used to buy this number. Null when no verification was used.
verification_id.title: Verification Id

voice_agent_id.description: Agent that answers calls to this number. Null: calls ring out.
voice_agent_id.title: Voice Agent Id

idempotency_key.description: Key that identifies this exact request when retrying.
